# `nlink-lab metrics`

<!-- generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit by hand -->

```text
Stream live metrics from a lab via Zenoh (no root required)

Usage: nlink-lab metrics [OPTIONS] <LAB>

Arguments:
  <LAB>
          Lab name

Options:
  -n, --node <NODE>
          Filter to specific node

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format (`--json` selects json too)
          
          [default: table]
          [possible values: table, json]

  -c, --count <COUNT>
          Number of samples then exit

      --zenoh-connect <ZENOH_CONNECT>
          Zenoh connect endpoint

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
